components.quote: (ii) 50% of Capital Expenditures, minus (iii) Discretionary Repurchase Obligation Payments paid in cash

components.quote: (iii) Discretionary Repurchase Obligation Payments paid in cash, to the extent not already deducted in calculating Consolidated EBITDA
components.note: Cash-paid discretionary ESOP repurchase payments, only to the extent not already deducted in Consolidated EBITDA (no double count).

components.quote: (iv) income tax expense for such period, net of tax refunds

components.quote: Indebtedness of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries (excluding net obligations under any Hedge Agreements)

terms.name: Indebtedness

components.quote: (a) all liabilities, obligations and indebtedness for borrowed money including, but not limited to, obligations evidenced by bonds, debentures, notes or other similar instruments
components.note: Includes bonds, debentures and notes (notes_bonds folded into this clause).

components.quote: (b) all obligations to pay the deferred purchase price of property or services (excluding pension and other obligations owed for the services of officers
components.note: Expressly includes non-competition, earn-out and similar payment obligations. Excludes officer/director/employee pension and service obligations and ordinary-course trade payables not more than 90 days past due or contested in good faith with GAAP reserves.

components.quote: (c) the Attributable Indebtedness of such Person with respect to such Person’s Capital Lease Obligations and Synthetic Leases
components.note: Capital lease and synthetic lease obligations at their Attributable Indebtedness amount, regardless of GAAP treatment. Pre-ASC 842 operating leases remain excluded (Section 1.3(b)).

components.quote: (d) all obligations of such Person under conditional sale or other title retention agreements relating to property purchased by such Person
components.note: To the extent of the value of the property; excludes customary supplier title retentions in the ordinary course.

components.quote: (e) all Indebtedness of any other Person secured by a Lien on any asset owned or being purchased by such Person
components.note: Whether or not assumed or limited in recourse; amount = lesser of asset FMV and the debt (see the valuation sentence).

components.quote: (f) all obligations, contingent or otherwise, of any such Person relative to the face amount of letters of credit, whether or not drawn
components.note: Face amount of letters of credit whether or not drawn (so undrawn LCs count), Reimbursement Obligations, and banker's acceptances.

components.quote: (g) all obligations of any such Person in respect of Disqualified Equity Interests
(h) all net obligations of such Person under any Hedge Agreements
components.note: Valued at Hedge Termination Value. Excluded again by Consolidated Total Indebtedness, so it does not reach the covenant.

components.quote: (i) all Guarantees of any such Person with respect to any of the foregoing
For all purposes hereof, the Indebtedness of any Person shall include the Indebtedness of any partnership or joint venture
components.note: Includes debt of partnerships/JVs where the Person is a general partner or joint venturer (not JVs that are corporations or LLCs), unless expressly non-recourse.

components.quote: In respect of Indebtedness of another Person secured by a Lien on the assets of the specified Person, the amount of such Indebtedness
components.note: Clause (e) amount = lesser of (x) FMV of the encumbered assets and (y) the secured debt.

components.quote: The amount of any net obligation under any Hedge Agreement on any date shall be deemed to be the Hedge Termination Value thereof
components.note: Clause (h) amount = Hedge Termination Value.

terms.notes: Nine lettered clauses plus three trailing sentences. Judgment calls / acceptable alternatives: (c) as term_reference to Attributable Indebtedness, or split into capital_finance_leases + synthetic_leases; (f) as letters_of_credit_drawn or split to add bankers_acceptances_guaranties (one clause, so one component preferred); (b) may carry an extra earnouts part; (a) may carry an extra notes_bonds part; trade-payable and pension carve-outs inside (b) may be separate excluded_debt parts. The two valuation sentences may instead be recorded as notes on (e) and (h). Section 1.3 (100% of principal; frozen pre-ASC 842 lease treatment) applies but is a calculation rule outside the definition. | source filled by category default (#19); not scored against the key.
